cc:Work.dc:description: Source: http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herakles_och_Antaios,_Nordisk_familjebok.png; original page: http://runeberg.org/nfba/0622.html This image was first published in the 1st (1876–1899), 2nd (1904–1926) or 3rd (1923–1937) edition of Nordisk familjebok. The copyrights for that book have expired and this image is in the public domain. It was uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by user Väsk. Vectorized by Warszawianka.
